champion.tips: MALPHITE TIPS AND TRICKS You’re weak in the early game. Try and avoid skirmishing with the enemy especially if they’re strong in the early game. When laning against ranged champions, be prepared to sacrifice some CS for XP so they don’t poke you down. Avoid standing too close to them when not last hitting so they cannot attack you for free. In team fights, you can either look for a multi-person knockup with your Ultimate, or try to isolate a target that’s overextended and too far forward.
champion.builds: THE BEST MALPHITE BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR MID IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Malphite Mid build, you should take Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Arcane Comet as your keystone, followed by Manaflow Band, Transcendence and Scorch in the primary tree, as well as Cheap Shot and Ultimate Hunter in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Malignance as your first item, followed by Sorcerer's Shoes and Stormsurge. For your last 3 items, you should build Shadowflame, Rabadon's Deathcap and finish with Zhonya's Hourglass. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - E - W. Right now, this build has 52.0% winrate over 2 006 matches played. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Arcane Comet as your keystone, Manaflow Band, Transcendence and Scorch in the primary tree, and Overgrowth with Second Wind in the secondary tree, as well as Attack Speed, Health Scaling, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Hollow Radiance as your first item, then Mercury's Treads as a second item and Thornmail as a third item. You want to finish the build with Frozen Heart, Jak'Sho, The Protean and Unending Despair. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - E - W. This build is currently sitting at a 50.9% win rate across 277 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Malphite Mid build in the current patch, try Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells, Grasp of the Undying, Shield Bash, Conditioning and Overgrowth as your primary rune tree, and Manaflow Band with Transcendence as your secondary tree. Use Attack Speed, Health Scaling and Health Scaling as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Sunfire Aegis as your first item, then finish Plated Steelcaps as your second item, and Thornmail as third item. The last 3 options are Frozen Heart, Randuin's Omen and Jak'Sho, The Protean. The ability order for this build is Q - E - W. As of the current patch, this build has a 56.2% win rate over 249 matches played. Situational Malphite Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Malphite build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Malphite runes page.
